title: Mobile Sample
description: An interactive baseline walkthrough of the six high-level steps for taking a Mission Surface prototype from starter download to Request dashboard feedback.
limitations: GitHub connection, publishing, comments, and feedback submission are simulated
No files are downloaded and no changes are persisted

items.content: Evaluate whether the complete six-step setup path is understandable before the walkthrough begins.
Evaluate whether the starter's purpose and governed repository structure are clear.
Evaluate whether Mission Surface's read-only GitHub access boundary is unmistakable.
Evaluate whether the choice between GitHub Pages and local image preparation is easy to make.
Evaluate whether verification covers both technical integrity and the reviewer-visible experience.
Evaluate whether review tools and contextual commenting feel connected to the demonstrated journey.
Evaluate whether the handoff from prototype review to the Request dashboard closes the feedback loop.
